title: The Gallery of Things That Will Never Be Paid

features.name: unpaid portrait
features.desc-on-touch: A photograph of a debt frozen mid-refusal. The thing that will not be paid stares back at you from its frame, patient and eternal.

features.name: register of infinity
features.desc-on-touch: A ledger that learns new debts each time you read it. The sum grows inward. Some debts never had an amount; they were always immeasurable.

features.name: image-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Places photograph themselves paying, but nothing changes in the photograph. The building is still unpaid. The place still owes.

features.name: debt-dream
features.desc-on-touch: Forms shift like sleep, but you are awake. Each object becomes a list of what it cost, and none of them subtract.

features.name: payment threshold
features.desc-on-touch: The point beyond which paying becomes impossible. Not because the debt is too large, but because time runs wrong here.

inscription: here, images of unpaid things learn to photograph themselves, and the debt that cannot be measured becomes the one thing whose price never changes

file.name: Debt_Form_Gallery_Index_Final.txt
file.note: A catalog of things that will never be paid: places, moments, futures, the spaces between breaths

toward the deepest debt, the one that has no beginning
to where things learn what it means to be owed
